Messages.Body:
here are a few to start:

Heidelburg Castle, Germany - Master: unique location
Clan: any
Cost Minion:
Cost Meth.: 2
Discipline: none
Text: Tap to transfer equip. cards, move blood, and transfer
retainers between any two ready vampires you control
(you may choose the amount of blood you move and which
cards you transfer)

Spiritual Protector - Unique Retainer
Clan: Giovanni
Cost Minion: 3
Cost Meth.:
Discipline: none
Text: 1 life. Spiritual Protector is immune to damage that is not
aggravated. Minions blocking or blocked by the vampire
with this retainer cannot use equipment in combat.

Rutor's Hand - Action
Clan: any
Cost Minion: 1
Cost Meth.:
Discipline: Thamaturgy
Text: +1 stealth action. Put this card on the acting vampire.
The vampire takes 1 aggravated damage (may not be
prevented). Beginning with your next turn, the vampire gets
one additional untap during each of your minion phases for
the remainder of the game.
Bold: As above, but the aggravated damage may be prevented.

New Vampires:

Harood - Nosferatu
Disciplines: |2|1|0|2|0|0|0|2|2|1|0|0|
Capacity: 11
Title: Inner Circle (4 votes)
Text: During your untap phase, you may look at one card in your
prey's inactive region. +2 bleed.

If you could keep your submitions in the same format as above.
this will make it easier for me to compile the list. In the
disciplines of the Vampires, they are in alphabetical order.
1=normal 2=superior

thanks for your help.

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: Hector Sosa, card erratta?
Date: 24 Nov 1995 21:18:50 GMT
Message-ID: <495crq$g...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

Note that not all of the cards that have been reworded have functional
changes. For example, several cards that deal damage outside of combat now say
that the "damage may not be prevented." However, this is not a functional
change to the set, as the rules only allow for preventing damage during strike
resolution.
